episodes.synopsis: What can a single Tamer do against an entire army of 10,000 monsters with just a wolf, a dryad and a handful of slimes?
episodes.title: I Wanted to Protect the Town

episodes.synopsis: Yuji’s party members don’t have a high opinion of Tamers, but his tracking skills are too valuable to pass up. Maybe Yuji can change their minds once they see him in action.
episodes.title: Trying Out a Party

episodes.synopsis: Yuji overdoes everything, even when he's trying not to. But when a dragon appears underneath the calamitous blue moon, the Tamer may be the only one who can prevent disaster.
episodes.title: I Meant Too Strong

episodes.synopsis: A dragon is a formidable opponent. That's precisely why Yuji needs to get up close and personal to fight it with... a dagger!?
episodes.title: Truly Unusual Situations

episodes.synopsis: A hard freeze means a high demand for firewood. It's time for Yuji to use his overpowered skills for a more mundane purpose, especially since delicious food is involved!
episodes.title: That Cold Looked Troubling

episodes.synopsis: The bad news? There's something sinister going on in that remote village. The good news? The cult stationed there has no idea Yuji is on to them.
episodes.title: Infiltrating an Ominous Village

episodes.synopsis: Yuuji has a price on his head and two assassins are after him. He could easily defeat them, but that would only make him a bigger target. This calls for a more unique approach.
episodes.title: Assassins in Pursuit

episodes.synopsis: If Yuji wants quality armor, he’ll need quality materials. And that means hunting a rare monster.
episodes.title: We Got Some Monster Armor

episodes.synopsis: Yuji must now protect the town from the kaiju-level threat of a rampaging Fire Dragon.
episodes.title: We Fought a Fire Dragon

episodes.synopsis: According to legend, an emissary is supposed to stop the Blue Moon of Salvation’s leader. Steyl is now convinced that Yuji is the one he’s been waiting for.
episodes.title: Didn’t Seem Like a Good Time for That

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Yuji and Walter begins in earnest, but that is only the beginning.
episodes.title: The Revelation Came True

episodes.synopsis: Yuji may be strong, but he can’t fight the enemy and defend all the towns at once. If he wants to win, he needs to place his trust in all the friends he made along the way.
episodes.title: My Isekai Life
